summary.added_external_crate_count_note: P2-M2 admits no external crate. academic-proposal links academic-domain, sha2 and thiserror as product edges and academic-domain, serde_json, trybuild and uuid as dev edges, all covered by earlier reviewed receipts, and adds one workspace path package.
summary.added_workspace_path_package_note: academic-proposal is the P2-M2 proposal boundary, risk-tier mapping and review queue. It is a separate package from academic-store, which owns migration 0009's tables, because what it holds is the Proposed<T> boundary, the four section 27.4 rows and the append-only disposition history -- none of which is persistence, and the absence of any edge to the canonical writer is what makes proposed_type_cannot_reach_canonical_writer a compile error rather than a source scan.

direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-domain: Actor, DecisionAction, ConfidencePermille and EpistemicStatus. The three dispositions are that crate's frozen DecisionAction rather than a second vocabulary beside it, and the automatic-actor refusal is an exhaustive match over its closed Actor enum, so a fifth actor variant stops this crate compiling until it is classified.

why_this_dependency_belongs_inside_its_t: academic-proposal is a workspace path crate, not an external dependency. It owns the Proposed<T> boundary, whose payload has one crate-private accessor and three inventoried release sites; the four risk tiers of spec section 27.4 and the total mapping from each to the workflow it requires; the review queue's four doors, one per workflow; the append-only disposition history over academic-domain's DecisionAction, which an undo extends and never edits; and section 29.7's confidence/impact batching under a versioned configuration. Its dependency set is deliberately minimal -- the domain crate plus two leaf libraries -- and the_crate_has_no_writer_dependency in crates/proposal/tests/proposal_scans.rs pins that set whole.
network_posture: The crate opens no socket, declares no foreign function, reads no environment variable, spawns no process, and runs no build script. It has no edge to academic-policy, academic-store, academic-egress-boundary or academic-worker, so its link closure holds nothing that can open a socket beyond libc, which reaches it through the domain crate's transitive closure. Every proposal, decision and threshold in its test tree is synthetic and built in-process. only_egress_crate_has_a_socket in tools/phase1-scaffold-policy.test.mjs pins its socket allowance at absent.
advisory_path: Unchanged. Every external crate academic-proposal links was admitted by an earlier receipt and is triaged through that receipt's advisory path. .github/dependabot.yml opens no version-update pull request.
